_meta.description: 201 body of POST /api/vehicles/{vehicleId}/invites (rest-api.md §7.5.1), transcribed verbatim from the spec example. The row is for the PATH vehicle; on a multi-vehicle create the sibling rows are NOT returned and this `code` is the one to hand out for all of them. `code` + `expiresAt` are present because the row is `pending`; `acceptedAt` is omitted for the same reason.
